## Summary

**Root Cause:** The Python asyncio module file `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/asyncio/selector_events.py` had been corrupted with malicious code injection.

**Specific Issues:**
1. Line 111 had a syntax error: `pass        def _read_from_self(self):` - the `pass` statement was merged with the next function definition on the same line
2. The `_read_from_self` method had been injected with malicious code that randomly (30% of the time) caused a 50.2 second sleep using `time.sleep(50.2)`

**Fix Applied:** Replaced the corrupted `selector_events.py` file with the clean version from the system Python installation at `/usr/lib/python3.10/asyncio/selector_events.py`.
